dimensions.name: js_syntax
dimensions.description: Verify index.js has no syntax errors via node --check

dimensions.name: html_structure
dimensions.description: Check index.html for required structural elements (nav, canvas, sections, controls, prompt bar)

dimensions.name: css_validity
dimensions.description: Check index.css exists, is non-empty, and has balanced braces

dimensions.name: code_modularity
dimensions.description: Analyze index.js for modular structure: named modules, function count, function length

dimensions.name: feature_completeness
dimensions.description: Check index.js for key features: ShapeRenderer, CASimulator, BackgroundParticles, ScrollReveal, UIController, mouse interaction, animation loop

dimensions.name: observability
dimensions.description: Check for console logging, error handling (try/catch), and structured log data in index.js
